main_text.p: dente, dissipentur; ne quod à malevolo olim Gallo a Monachus Pon-tiniacensis in Vitâ S. Edm. MS. in Biblioth. Lambeth. prop. fin. in opprobrium nostræ Gentis causâ S. Edmundi decessoris tui, scriptum est [Consuetudinis est Terræ illi bonis Prælatis injurias inferre] nostris temporibus renovetur. Ita vovet ex animo,

page.notes: The marginal note is marked "a" in the text beside "Gallo" and in the margin; the note mark in the text is placed before "in opprobrium". The bracketed passage is printed in italics within the text. The page carries a running head above the rules. The signature "HEN. WHARTON." is set in small capitals and is given as a plain line.
